feeds.name: TED — EU tender notices
feeds.yields: EU-threshold public tenders with CZ place of performance — the COMPLETE JURISDICTION, one all-CPV query with no classification clause; notices carry buyer, value, tender deadline and their CPV codes as free labels (sector is the model half's job, `sector` in _needs).

access.basis: Public API, no auth, no rate terms published; EU open-data licence.

expected_yield.basis: MEASURED 2026-08-24: a 30-day CZ window with NO classification-cpv clause returns ~4,754 notices vs 1,208 under the old 5-CPV-group subset — the subset silently discarded ~75% of the jurisdiction, which is why the groups died under the 2026-08-24 selection law (jurisdiction-complete coverage: place-of-performance CZE plus a publication-date window is the whole query; CPV codes stay in the fetched fields as free labels). The default 60-day window therefore lands ~9,500 notices; the ceiling is the fetcher's 60-page safety cap x 250/page. Counts items_fetched. Replace with a rolling median once six fetch_log runs exist.

feeds.name: Hlídač státu — registr smluv
feeds.yields: CZ public contracts from the state contracts register as a THRESHOLD FIREHOSE: one query, every contract over 20M CZK (~EUR 800k), no keyword selection — sector labels are the model half's job (`sector` in _needs). Subject, VAT-inclusive value and signature date.

access.basis: Free API key issued on request at hlidacstatu.cz/api; open-data terms. The token is present and the env var is named HLIDAC_STATU_TOKEN — NOT HLIDAC_TOKEN, which is the name an earlier blocker note assumed and which does not exist. Recorded here so nobody re-derives it. Verified live 2026-08-20: 7/7 queries HTTP 200, 1,061 contracts, zero login-page bodies.

expected_yield.basis: MEASURED THRESHOLD VOLUMES plus a hard page ceiling. Probed live 2026-08-24 against api.hlidacstatu.cz: cenaSDph:>100000000 -> 95 contracts in July 2026 (1,079 full year); >50000000 -> 182; >20000000 -> 457. scripts/fetch_hlidac.sh issues ONE firehose query (cenaSDph:>20000000, windowed on datumUzavreni — the keyword queries died 2026-08-24 under the selection law: threshold and taxonomy only, labels are model judgment) and pages it to HLIDAC_PAGES (default 60) pages of 25, so 1,500 items is a hard maximum; the default 70-day window holds ~1,070 at the measured ~460/month. The floor brackets a thin month. Counts items_fetched. required_fields note carried over from the 2026-08-20 correction: cenaSDph is a QUERY-DSL field appearing on 0 of 75 response items across three authenticated 200s — it filters, it never appears in a body — so it must stay OUT of required_fields even though the firehose query now filters on it; the four named here were present 25/25 in all probes, and this is still the feed whose 302 login page was once stored as a .json payload.

GDPR NOTE, stated at registration: the payload's adresaPripominek field is a named civil servant's work email; the extractor never reads it and AC-GDPR1 refuses any record it would leak into.

expected_yield.basis: MEASURED 2026-08-25 on the live dataset: 8,708 records total; 80 items touched in the trailing 30 days by datumPosledniUpravy (the window field the fetcher queries); 27-36 NEW materials/month by datumAutorizace (May 36, Jun 33, Jul 27). The default 70-day window therefore holds ~190 touched items and the fetcher's page cap (VEKLEP_PAGES=8 x 25) makes 200 a hard maximum. required_fields were chosen from a live 25-item probe: each named field was present on 25/25; predkladatel (submitter) was present on only 15/25 and so stays out of the contract and degrades to empty in the extractor. Counts items_fetched.

feeds.name: MPSV/ÚP — volná místa (vacancies)
feeds.yields: Monthly AGGREGATES of newly registered Czech Labour Office vacancies, by occupation theme and by theme x IČO: posting and seat counts, distinct-employer counts, annualised wage floor in EUR and NUTS-3 distribution. Never one record per vacancy. Source dataset: https://data.mpsv.cz/web/data/volna-mista-za-celou-cr

access.basis: The dataset licence explicitly disclaims copyright (neobsahuje-autorska-dila) AND the sui-generis database right (neni-chranena-zvlastnim-pravem-porizovatele-databaze) — re-read first-hand from volna-mista-metadata.jsonld on 2026-08-21. Note the SEPARATE GDPR obligation: the same distribution declares obsahuje-osobni-udaje, and the payload earns it (2,471 of 2,473 postings in one day carry a contact person's surname, 2,243 an email, 1,676 a phone). Licence permission is not privacy permission: scripts/mpsv_reduce.py applies a SOURCE-side field allowlist before anything is written, and refuses the whole run if a contact string survives.

expected_yield.basis: COUNTS AGGREGATES, NOT POSTINGS — this is the number scripts/normalize.py's yield check actually sees, because the payload is one item per aggregate. Measured end to end on the full 2026-07 window (27 of 31 daily increments present, 19.4 MB on the wire, 25 s): 46,716 changelog rows -> 35,921 distinct postings -> 6,597 novy -> 18 aggregates written (10 theme + 8 employer candidates) -> 16 after scripts/fetch_ares.sh applied the 6-record employer cap. The band 6-24 brackets that with room for a month in which several themes go quiet; architecture-v3.md 13.4 sizes the feed at 8-15 records/month. THE PREVIOUS BAND (100-8000) DESCRIBED RAW POSTINGS and would have declared this feed below-range on every correct run. THE CHANGELOG TRAP: the increment is a changelog, not a list of new items — a parser ignoring typZmenyOpenData records 46,716 new postings when 6,597 are new, a 7.1x flood into an append-only permanent log. typZmenyOpenData stays in required_fields and every aggregate carries its own novy/zmeneny/zruseny census (novy always equals the record's own `postings`), so 'the parser branches on change type' is checked by the FIELDS step rather than remembered.
